result.description: Compact fictional USB-C archival card designed for short-term transfer of documents, photos, and small media projects. Features a slim credit-card style body, reversible USB-C connector, and sequential read speeds up to 180MB/s for quick file movement across laptops, tablets, and phones. Marketed as a lightweight everyday carry accessory rather than a ruggedized storage device.
result.title: Aster Quill 64GB USB-C Archive Card
